text: On behalf of local residents, I am requesting that the existing maximum 1-hour parking regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the west side of Dudley Avenue, between Pemberton Avenue and Bishop Avenue be amended to No Parking Anytime. The change would be consistent with the regulations on the remaining segments of Dudley Avenue, between Finch Avenue East and Bishop Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing maximum 1-hour parking regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the west side of Dudley Avenue, between Finch Avenue East and Bishop Avenue. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Dudley Avenue, between Pemberton Avenue and Bishop Avenue.
